initiatives.name: Index clauses in fixed-price contracts
initiatives.how: Link price to a published containerboard index at renewal; commercial team owns, controlling tracks realisation monthly.
initiatives.basis: 40% capture of the 1.1% vs -3.4% price gap between indexed and fixed contracts

initiatives.name: Cost-to-serve pricing and order rules
initiatives.kpi: Cost-to-serve per tonne; share of loss-making customers
initiatives.how: Minimum order quantities, small-drop surcharges and consolidated delivery days for accounts below break-even.
initiatives.basis: Recover half of the negative contribution of 9 accounts and a quarter of the remaining EBITDA loss on 29 accounts

initiatives.name: Energy anomaly alerting
initiatives.kpi: MWh per tonne vs seasonal baseline, per plant per week
initiatives.how: Weekly rule on meter data flags drift early; maintenance fixes root cause at Sweden Central.
initiatives.basis: Excess energy at Sweden Central annualised from 39 affected weeks

initiatives.name: Trim-waste reduction at three plants
initiatives.kpi: Board usage, t of board per t sold
initiatives.how: Order combination and trim optimisation on the corrugator; close half of the gap to the best plant.
initiatives.basis: Half of the gap to best-plant board usage (Finland West 1.106, Sweden South 1.108, Baltics 1.136 vs best 1.099 t/t)

initiatives.name: Demand sensing for production planning
initiatives.how: Machine-learning forecast feeds sequencing to cut changeovers; prove it in one plant first.
initiatives.basis: 4% lower order-handling and changeover cost, to be proven in a pilot

initiatives.name: AI agent for month-end variance commentary
initiatives.kpi: Controller hours on commentary; days to close
initiatives.how: Agent drafts variance commentary from the bridge; controllers review and sign. Frees about 1,100 hours a year for analysis.
initiatives.basis: 6 controllers × 16 h per month, 95% of the drafting effort removed; value is capacity, not EBITDA
